# Fixed Banner

Use the **Fixed banner** template to display non-intrusive announcements or alerts at the top or bottom of your website.

![](https://files.readme.io/f1b332f747587a3e786e5d077de9194bc8787ef9832428c76940c4210c855f8d-in-web-fixed_banner.png)

* * *

## 

Settings

Setting| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Enter a short, clear and eye-catching title. Long titles may be truncated with “…”, depending on the user’s device or browser width.  
**Message**|  Yes| Enter a short message that highlights the main point.  
**Add button**|  No| Add an action button. Set the button text, button text color, action (**Redirect to URL** or **Close the campaign**), and background color.  
**Enable background overlay**|  No| Prevent users from interacting with the page while the notification is displayed.  
**Pop-up design** : **Location**|  Yes| Select where the banner appears on the page.  
**Pop-up design** : **Pop-up background color**|  Yes| Click the color palette to modify the banner's background color.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/a5839f22bc4f4dc785bf9257ec9ce6d6f01e25ea8b33aff7f8e663c4bb82821d-in-web-fixed-banner.png)

# Multiple Actions

Use the **Multiple actions** template to display an images and multiple call-to-action options that offer users clear choices.

![](https://files.readme.io/1e0321fc4f40f39d743dbca86429cdb2019f3f45ce252a243694a1bffb15ddb5-in-web-multiple-actions.png)

* * *

## 

Settings

Setting| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Enter a short, clear and eye-catching title. Long titles may be truncated with “…”, depending on the user’s device or browser width.  
**Message**|  Yes| Enter a short message that highlights the main point.  
**Add image**|  No| Add an image and select the image ratio and image fit.  
**Add button**|  No| Add action buttons to your notification.  
**Enable background overlay**|  No| Prevent users from interacting with the page while the notification is displayed.  
**Pop-up design**|  Yes| Select the notification position on desktop, and adjust the pop-up notification width, height, padding from browser edges, and background color.  
**Close button**|  Yes| Adjust the close button size, background color, icon size, and icon color.  
  
### 

Action buttons

An action button requires configuration for **Button class** , **Button text** , **Click action** , and button background color.

  * **Button class** :
    * Primary buttons direct users to take action.
    * Secondary buttons let users dismiss the pop-up notification.
  * **Click action** : Both primary and secondary button classes support three actions.
    * **Open URL** : Directs users to a specified URL. Use this for primary action buttons. This click action requires entering a **Button URL** and, optionally, determining whether to **Open the page in a new tab**.
    * **Close the pop-up notification** : Closes the pop-up notification. Users may see the in-web campaign again if trigger condition and frequency settings allow.
    * **Never show again (to the user)** : Closes and prevents this user from seeing this pop-up notification again. Use clear button text, such as “Never show again.”

![](https://files.readme.io/df53ef862c0aa82d9f8927d3b35a99afbd7e46c207a67025bb43b506200d53e8-in-web-multiple-actions-button.png)

> 🚧
> 
> ### 
> 
> Important
> 
> Only buttons configured with **Open URL** generate the `qg_inweb_clicked` event and contribute to **Clicks** metrics.
> 
> To segment users who clicked a specific action button, filter by:
> 
>   * Event name: `qg_inweb_clicked`
>     * Parameter: `callToActionText`, the button text (for example, "Sign Up Now"). This parameter is available only when the button uses **Open URL** click action.
>     * Parameter: `notificationId`, the campaign ID.
> 

> 
> To learn how to create a segment using a campaign’s notification ID, see [How do I segment by notification ID?](doc:how-do-i-segment-by-notification-id).

# Multiple Images

Use the **Multiple images** template to display a message with multiple images and action buttons in a horizontal or vertical gallery format.

![](https://files.readme.io/f8d0be371c60a67ae591aa4ef1149e2fc955b4d2f998cff7e90456a8bad6d096-in-web-multiple-images.png)

* * *

## 

Settings

Setting| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Enter a short, clear and eye-catching title. Long titles may be truncated with “…”, depending on the user’s device or browser width.  
**Image**|  Yes| Add up to four images. For each image, configure the **Message** , **Destination link** , **Button text** , and **Button URL**.  
**Image ratio**|  Yes| Select the aspect ratio for all images:  
  
• 3:2  
• 4:3  
• 1:1  
• 16:9  
**Add button**|  No| Add an action button for each image and specify the destination URL.  
**Enable background overlay**|  No| Prevent users from interacting with the page while the notification is displayed.  
**Desktop display**|  Yes| Select the pop-up notification layout for desktop users:  
  
• **Horizontal**  
• **Vertical**  
  
If the pop-up notification size exceeds the screen size, users can scroll to view the full message.  
  
Note: Layout and size settings don't apply to mobile devices.  
**Pop-up size in desktop**|  Yes| Set the pop-up notification width and height in pixels. If the adjusted size exceeds the user’s screen, it automatically adjusts to fit.  
**Title background color**|  Yes| Click the color palette to modify the title's background color.  
**Pop-up background color**|  Yes| Click the color palette to modify the pop-up notification's background color.  
  
![](https://files.readme.io/232f27e5022a50f6463e6a1f618cd3f74d1873a27f139718a1e612370ed5470c-multiple-images-template.png)

# Subscription Boost

Use the **Subscription boost** template to encourage users to enable web push notifications. It shows your custom message with an arrow that points to the browser's permission prompt, helping users understand where and how to subscribe.

![913](https://files.readme.io/d80b1c7-Screen_Shot_2020-12-28_at_10.38.25_AM.png)

* * *

## 

How it works

The subscription boost works alongside the browser's system prompt and optional custom prompts. Understanding the following behaviors is important:

  1. Triggering
     * Appears only when a user meets the real-time trigger rules you set.
     * Displays only for users whose web push notification setting is "Ask (Default)".
     * Disappears once the user responds to the system prompt by clicking "Allow" or "Block".

![](https://files.readme.io/e75860d-Screen_Shot_2021-01-22_at_3.58.07_PM.png)

  2. Interaction with **Opt-In Prompt** : If you've enabled an [**Opt-In Prompt**](doc:account-overview-web-pixel-settings#opt-in-prompt), this message appears after users click "Allow" on the opt-in prompt.

![](https://files.readme.io/7009f9d-Screen_Shot_2021-01-22_at_4.15.25_PM.png)

  3. Interaction with **Opt-In Tip** : If you've enabled the [**Opt-In Tip**](doc:account-overview-web-pixel-settings#opt-in-tip), it replaces the arrow in this message and guides users to manually allow notifications. This is useful for browsers with Quieter permission UI.

![](https://files.readme.io/e23ade2-Screen_Shot_2021-01-22_at_3.43.13_PM.png) ![760](https://files.readme.io/8934d85-Screen_Shot_2021-01-22_at_3.41.27_PM.png)

* * *

## 

Settings

A subscription boost requires the following configuration:

Setting| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Enter a short, clear, and eye-catching title. Long titles may be truncated with "…", depending on the user's device or browser width.  
**Message**|  Yes| Enter a short message that highlights the main point.  
  
> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Website preview isn't supported for subscription boosts template.

# HTML Editor

Use the HTML editor to create browser-based campaigns with custom branding and deep links. These campaigns run directly in the web browser, letting you deliver dynamic promotions without interrupting your users' browsing experience.

![](https://files.readme.io/37667edf951443cf21fd1d35933b5d6713df2681120088922997d496db99420c-inweb-html.png)

* * *

## 

Get started with templates

The HTML editor includes ready-to-use templates. To use a template in the template gallery below:

  1. Copy the HTML code for your chosen template.
  2. Paste the code into the **HTML body**.
  3. Search for `REPLACE` in the code and replace with your custom content.
  4. (Optional) Keep **Use overlay** toggled on to gray out the area outside of the banner. Clicking on the grayed out area will close the notification.



### 

Design guidelines

  * Images: Templates automatically resize images based on layout settings.
    * Use square images for item list layouts.
    * Non-square images are automatically resized based on width while maintaining original aspect ratio.
    * Supported formats: JPG, PNG, GIF
  * Text:
    * Keep it short and eye-catching.
    * Long titles might not wrap to a new line.

Fixed bottom image banner

fixed bottom image banner

    <style>
      .qg-inweb-container {
        position: fixed;
        bottom: 30px;
        width: 728px;
        height: 90px;
        overflow: hidden;
        background-color: #ccc;
      }
    
      .qg-inweb-close:not(:hover) {
        color: #fff;
        background-color: transparent;
      }
    
      .aiqua.aiqua__image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        background-size: 100% auto;
        background-position: bottom;
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
    
        /* CHANGE IMAGE URL HERE! */
        background-image: url(https://dummyimage.com/728x90/aaa/fff.png?text=image728x90&REPLACE_image);
      }
      
      .aiqua .aiqua__link {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }
    
      @media (max-width: 479px) {
        .qg-inweb-container {
          left: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          width: 100vw;
          height: calc(100vw * 90 / 728);
        }
      }
    </style>

    <style>
      .aiqua,
      .aiqua *,
      .aiqua *:before,
      .aiqua *:after {
        box-sizing: border-box;
        word-break: break-all;
      }
    
      .aiqua {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 520px;
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 30px 20px 20px;
        border-radius: 3px;
        font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif;
    
        /* MAY CHANGE COLOR HERE! */
        background-color: #fff;
        color: #000;
      }
      
      .aiqua .aiqua__title {
        margin: 0 0 20px;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 24px;
        font-weight: bold;
        color: inherit;
      }
      
      .aiqua .aiqua__list,
      .aiqua .aiqua__item {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
      }
      
      .aiqua .aiqua__list {
        display: block;
      }
      
      .aiqua .aiqua__item {
        margin-bottom: 10px;
      }
      
      .aiqua .aiqua__item-link {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
    
      .aiqua .aiqua__item-link:hover {
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
    
      .aiqua .aiqua__item-img {
        /* MAY CHANGE IMAGE SIZE HERE! */
        width: 35%;
        height: auto;

### 

Countdown timer

This HTML template shows a banner at the top of the webpage with a countdown timer.

  * Use the`final_date_time` variable to set the end time of the countdown timer.
  * The user's browser time is used to calculate the remaining time in the countdown timer.
  * If the `final_date_time` passes before the end of the campaign, the countdown timer will disappear from the in-web notification.
  * Since you may have users in different time zones, set the `final_date_time` to be at least one day later than the end time of the in-web campaign.

      .aiqua_countdown span {
          position:relative;
          display:inline-block;
          padding:0 .25em;
          margin:0 .06125em;
          z-index:1;
    
          -webkit-transform:perspective(750);
          -moz-transform:perspective(750);
          -ms-transform:perspective(750);
          transform:perspective(750);
    
          -webkit-transform-style:preserve-3d;
          -moz-transform-style:preserve-3d;
          -ms-transform-style:preserve-3d;
          transform-style:preserve-3d;
      }
    
      .aiqua_countdown span:before,
      .aiqua_countdown span:after {
          position:absolute;
          left:0;
          top:0;
          right:0;
          bottom:0;
          color:#C74224; /*Color of count down timer*/
          text-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff;
          background:#ffffff; /*Background color of count down timer*/
          border-radius:.125em;
          outline:1px solid transparent; /* fix jagged edges in ff */
    
          -webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;
          -moz-backface-visibility:hidden;
          -ms-backface-visibility:hidden;
          backface-visibility:hidden;
    
          -webkit-transition:-webkit-transform .75s, opacity .75s;
          -moz-transition:-moz-transform .75s, opacity .75s;
          -ms-transition:-ms-transform .75s, opacity .75s;
          transition:transform .75s, opacity .75s;
      }
    
      .aiqua_countdown span:before {
          opacity:1;
          z-index:1;
          content:attr(data-old);
    
          -webkit-transform-origin:0 0;
          -moz-transform-origin:0 0;
          -ms-transform-origin:0 0;
          transform-origin:0 0;
    
          -webkit-transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);
          -moz-transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);
          -ms-transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);
          transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);
      }
    
      .aiqua_countdown span:after {
          opacity:0;
          z-index:2;
          content:attr(data-now);
    
          -webkit-transform-origin:0 100%;
          -moz-transform-origin:0 100%;
          -ms-transform-origin:0 100%;
          transform-origin:0 100%;
    
          -webkit-transform:translate3d(0,-102.5%,0) rotateX(90deg);
          -moz-transform:translate3d(0,-102.5%,0) rotateX(90deg);
          -ms-transform:translate3d(0,-102.5%,0) rotateX(90deg);
          transform:translate3d(0,-102.5%,0) rotateX(90deg);
      }
    
      .aiqua_countdown .flip:before {
          opacity:0;
          -webkit-transform:translate3d(0,102.5%,0) rotateX(-90deg);
          -moz-transform:translate3d(0,102.5%,0) rotateX(-90deg);
          -ms-transform:translate3d(0,102.5%,0) rotateX(-90deg);
          transform:translate3d(0,102.5%,0) rotateX(-90deg);
      }
    
      .aiqua_countdown .flip:after {
          opacity:1;
          -webkit-transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);
          -moz-transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);
          -ms-transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);
          transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotateX(0);
      }
    </style>

      var final_date_time = '2021-08-30 11:50:00'; 
        var Clock = (function(){
            var exports = function(element, element_label, final_count_down) {
              this._element = element;
              this._element_time = element.querySelector('.aiqua_time');
              this._element_label = element.querySelector('.aiqua_label');
              this._final_count_down = final_count_down;
              
              if(element_label) element_label.innerHTML = this._final_count_down;
              var final_datetime = this._final_count_down.split(' ');
                var final_date = final_datetime[0].split('-');
                var final_time = final_datetime[1].split(':');
                this._final_datetime = new Date();
                this._final_datetime.setDate(1);
                this._final_datetime.setMonth(parseInt(final_date[1])-1);
                this._final_datetime.setDate(final_date[2]);
                this._final_datetime.setYear(final_date[0]);
                this._final_datetime.setHours(final_time[0]); 
                this._final_datetime.setMinutes(final_time[1]); 
                this._final_datetime.setSeconds(final_time[2]); 
                
                var html_time = '';
                var html_label = '';
                for (var i=0;i<7;i++) {
                  html_time += '<td>';
                  if(i%2==0) html_time += '</span>&nbsp;</span><span>&nbsp;</span>';
                  else if(i>2) html_time += ':';
                  else html_time += '&nbsp;';
                  html_time += '</td>';
                }
                this._element_time.innerHTML = html_time;
                this._element_label.innerHTML = '<td>Day(s)</td><td></td><td>Hour(s)</td><td></td><td>Minute(s)</td><td></td><td>Second(s)</td>';
                this._slots = this._element_time.getElementsByTagName('span');
                this._attributes = this._element_label.getElementsByTagName('td');
                this._tick();
            };
            
            exports.prototype = {
                _tick:function() {
                    var current_time = new Date();
                    var lastSeconds = Math.floor((this._final_datetime - current_time) / 1000); 
                    this._lastSeconds = lastSeconds;
                    var day = Math.floor(lastSeconds / 86400);
                    lastSeconds %= 86400;
                    if(day==0){
                      this._element_time.querySelector('td').style = 'display:none';
                      this._element_label.querySelector('td').style = 'display:none';
                    }
                    var hour = Math.floor(lastSeconds / 3600); 
                    lastSeconds %= 3600; 
                    var minute = Math.floor(lastSeconds / 60); 
                    lastSeconds %= 60; 
                    var second = lastSeconds;               
                    this._update(this._pad(day) + this._pad(hour) + this._pad(minute) + this._pad(second));
                    var self = this;
                    if(this._lastSeconds > 0){
                    setTimeout(function(){
                        self._tick();
                    },1000);
                }else{
                  this._element.style = 'display:none;';
                }
                },
                _pad:function(value) {
                    return ('0' + value).slice(-2);
                },
                _update:function(timeString) {
                    var i=0,l=this._slots.length,value,slot,now;
                    for (;i<l;i++) {
                        value = timeString.charAt(i);
                        slot = this._slots[i];
                        
                        now = slot.dataset.now;
    
                        if (!now) {
                            slot.dataset.now = value;
                            slot.dataset.old = value;
                            continue;
                        }
    
                        if (now !== value) {
                            this._flip(slot,value);
                        }
                    }
                },
                _flip:function(slot,value) {
                    // setup new state
                    slot.classList.remove('flip');
                    slot.dataset.old = slot.dataset.now;
                    slot.dataset.now = value;
                    
                    // force dom reflow
                    slot.offsetLeft;
    
                    // start flippin
                    slot.classList.add('flip');
                }
            };
            
            return exports;
        }());
        
        var aiqua_clock_text = document.querySelector('.aiqua_clock_date_text');
        var aiqua_clock = document.querySelector('.aiqua_countdown');
        if(aiqua_clock) new Clock(aiqua_clock, aiqua_clock_text, final_date_time);
    })();" />
        </div>
      </div>
      
      <a class="aiqua__button" type="button" href="https://www.example.com/Index.aspx">Buy It!</a> <!-- input the destination URL here>
    </div>

### 

Spinning wheel

This HTML template allows you to create an interactive spin-to-win game in your browser where users enter their email, and spin wheel to win coupons or discounts.

After the user spins the wheel, a `luckywheel_played` event will be logged and the parameters `{email: "[[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)"}` will be stored into the user's profile.

The following HTML template support a spinning wheel that divides into 8 equal segments, each representing a prize outcome. You can use this table to customize all template elements. Search for the value in the "Search for" column and replace with your content.

Element| Search for| Configuration  
---|---|---  
Pointer image| `REPLACE-POINTER`| Replace it with the image URL of pointer that indicates the winning segment. ([Example](https://upload.cc/i1/2020/08/07/cyB6NL.png%5D\(https://upload.cc/i1/2020/08/07/cyB6NL.png\)))  
Wheel image| `REPLACE-WHEEL`| Replace it with the image URL of spinning wheel graphic with 8 segments ([Example](%5Bhttps://cdn.qgraph.io/img/hosting/4d9b48a084aaf66e145a/1S5-bo8-bo5A1S8ObY-wGAg4GFgAGMCJ7w7UVS7zPcHt0IOvVSwxjS0AjS0xblw.png%5D\(https://cdn.qgraph.io/img/hosting/4d9b48a084aaf66e145a/1S5-bo8-bo5A1S8ObY-wGAg4GFgAGMCJ7w7UVS7zPcHt0IOvVSwxjS0AjS0xblw.png\))). Make sure the wheel image is aligned with the lucky draw results.  
Title| `REPLACE-TITLE`| Replace it with the campaign title in the creative.  
Description| `REPLACE-DESC`| Replace it with instructions.  
Button text| `REPLACE-SPIN`| Replace it with a call to action button text.  
Cancel text| `REPLACE-CANCEL`| Replace it with the cancel wording on the creative.  
Error messages| -| Replace it with the message when email field is blank or user entered an invalid email address.  
Lucky draw result text| `lucky_result`| Replace it with prize names. For example the lucky draw has eight results:   
  
• For `num / cat <=`1, 2, 7, 8, 9, 10, there is a 10% possibility of landing on one of these results.  
• For `num / cat <=`4, 6, there is a 20% possibility of landing on one of these results.  
• For `num / cat <=`1, 7, 9, the result is no prize.  
• For `num / cat <=`2, 4, 6, 8, 10, users will receive a prize.  
Lucky draw result prompt| `lucky_tip`| Replace it with messages shows to users after spinned the wheel. For example:  
  
• If the user wins a prize, it will show "You got XXX !", the coupon will be presented with the wording of "COUPON: `lucky_coupon`".  
• If the user doesn't win a prize, it will show "Oops! Try again tomorrow!"  
Coupon| `lucky_coupon`| Replace it with the coupon code to display.  
  
HTML
    
    
    <div class="aiqua">
      <div class="aiqua__luckyspin">
        <img onclick="javascript:document.querySelector('.aiqua__button').click();" src="REPLACE-POINTER" class="aiqua__pointer"/>
        <img src="REPLACE-WHEEL" class="aiqua__spinwheel"/>
      </div>
      <div class="aiqua__content">
        <div class="aiqua__header">
          &nbsp;
        </div>

# Slider

A slider can display multiple big images in a single notification. Build a slider with 2 to 10 image cards with text, deep links, or icons.

![1800](https://files.readme.io/e0989875c8ec08de4584391589428776a144ccb252af045cbdbfa67b02794e30-ios-slider.png)

* * *

## 

Regular campaigns

To create a slider notification for iOS, configure the **Template** and optionally, the **Display settings**.

### 

Template

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Subtitle**|  No| Extra text that appears below the title.| -  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the notification. Enter a web URL or deep link to a specific page or screen in your app. If not set, users go to your default website.  
  
Options:  
• **Single URL across channels**  
• **Custom URL per channel**|  -  
**Slider images**|  Yes| Upload 2 to 10 images. To set up each one, click the expand icon on the card.  
  
For each image, add:  
• **Deep link**  
• **Key-value pairs** (optional)| • Recommended: 1024 x 512 pixels  
• Recommended aspect ratio: 2:1  
• Maximum file size: 10 MB or less  
**Key-value pairs**|  No| Map custom identifiable keys to their values. To learn more, see [Receive key-value pairs](doc:customizing-push-notifications-ios).| -  
**Customize notification sound**|  No| [Set a custom notification sound](doc:custom-push-notification-sound-for-ios) for the campaign.| -  
**Badge number**|  No| When users receive the campaign, the badge number entered is shown on the app icon. If not selected, no change is made to your app's badge settings.| -  
  
### 

(Optional) Display settings

Setting| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Wake app in background**|  No| Allows your app to fetch certain operations in the background. To learn more, see [Handling Push Notifications](doc:handling-push-notifications-for-ios#2-handling-silent-push-notifications).

# Standard

Send a basic push notification using a standard creative, with the option to include up to three media or action buttons. A standard iOS push creative is displayed in two notification states: collapsed and expanded.

![1984](https://files.readme.io/14f7c4261b831917caf04e8329ae5956aa59fc5d21f5f9695668ec254f1c0309-ios-standard.png)

* * *

## 

Regular campaigns

To create a standard notification for iOS, you'll need to configure the **Template** section, and can optionally customize the **Display settings**.

### 

Template

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Supports plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, and emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Subtitle**|  No| Extra text that appears below the title.| -  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Supports plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, and emoji.| Recommended: 30–40 characters  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the notification. Enter a web URL or deep link to a specific page or screen in your app. If not set, users go to your default website.  
  
Options:  
• **Single URL across channels**  
• **Custom URL per channel**|  -  
**Media attachment**|  No| Add a **Media URL** in this field to attach an image, GIF, video, or audio clip to your notification. It can also be [personalized](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) based on user activities.| Use HTTPS URLs when hosting any of the following media attachments.   
  
Image:  
• Recommended image size:  
\- **1:1** layout: 512 x 512 pixels   
\- **2:1** layout: 1024 x 512 pixels   
• Supported file format: GIF, JPEG, PNG   
• Recommended file size: 10 MB   
  
Audio:  
• Supported file format: MP3, MPEG-4 audio  
• Recommended file size: 5 MB  
  
Video:  
• Supported file format: MPEG, MPEG-2, MPEG-4, AVI   
• Recommended file size: 50 MB  
**Action category**|  No| This gives a label to your group of action buttons. Leave this blank when sending a standard creative.| -  
**Customize notification sound**|  No| [Set a custom notification sound](doc:custom-push-notification-sound-for-ios) for the campaign.| • Supported length: 30 seconds or less   
• Supported format: AIFF (.aif)  
**Key-value pairs**|  No| Map custom identifiable keys to their values. To learn more, see [(Optional) Receiving Key-Value Pairs](doc:customizing-push-notifications-ios).| -  
**Badge number**|  No| When users receive the campaign, the badge number entered is shown on the app icon. If not selected, no change is made to your app's badge settings.| -  
  
> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> In collapsed mode, images are displayed as squares and will be cropped if the aspect ratio is not 1:1.

### 

(Optional) Display settings

Setting| Required| Description  
---|---|---  
**Wake app in background**|  No| Allows your app to fetch certain operations in the background. To learn more, see [Handling Push Notifications](doc:handling-push-notifications-for-ios#2-handling-silent-push-notifications).

# Kakao (Chingu Talk) Creatives

Learn how to design Kakao ChinguTalk creatives.

[Kakao Chingu Talk](doc:campaigns-message-create-kakao) creatives let you send text-based content with optional images and buttons.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Notes and limitations
> 
>   * To use images in your campaigns, you must first upload them to Kakao's server through the WiseMOKA dashboard. Contact your customer success manager for assistance. See Generate image URLs for instructions.
>   * This campaign type doesn't support dynamic content.
>   * Live preview isn't available. The preview panel shows a static template. To review your actual content, select **Send test creative**.
> 


* * *

## 

Settings

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Label content as advertising**|  No| Labels your message as an ad to comply with local laws.| -  
**Insert Image**|  No| Enter an **Image URL** to include an image.| See Image specifications  
**Message**|  Yes| The body text. Enter plain text, emoji, or short URL.| • **Normal Image** : 400 chars max  
• **Wide Image** : 76 chars max  
• **No image** : 400 chars max  
**Include Action Buttons**|  No| Add up to five buttons.| • **Button text** : Text displayed on the button  
• **URL** : Must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
### 

Image specifications

If you use images, you must upload them to the WiseMOKA dashboard first to generate an image URL that follows the following specifications:

Specification| Normal Image| Wide Image  
---|---|---  
Recommended size| 720 x 720 pixels| 800 x 600 pixels  
Supported formats| JPG, PNG| JPG, PNG  
Max file size| 500 KB| 2 MB  
Dimensions| • Min width: 500px  
• Aspect ratio: 2:1 to 3:4| • Max aspect ratio: 4:3  
  
* * *

## 

Generate image URLs

To include images, upload them to the WiseMOKA dashboard to generate a URL. Ensure your images meet the [official Kakao specifications](https://www.infobip.com/docs/kakaotalk/message-types#image-chingu-talk). To generate the image URL:

  1. Log in to the WiseMOKA dashboard (credentials provided by Infobip).

  2. Go to the left menu, select **Chingutalk Image** (친구톡 이미지), and then select **Registration** (등록).

![](https://files.readme.io/58bb032-Screen_Shot_2022-01-18_at_2.43.11_PM.png)
  3. Fill out the fields in the pop-up window:

     * **Kakao Channel ID** (카카오채널ID): Select your channel.
     * **Image type** (이미지 유형): Select **Chingutalk Image** (친구톡 이미지) for normal images or **Chingutalk Wide** (친구톡 와이드) for wide images.
     * **Image code** (이미지 코드): Create a unique code using only letters, numbers, hyphens `(-)`, and underscores `(_)`.
     * **Image name** (이미지명): Name your image.
     * **Chingutalk Image URL** (친구톡 이미지 URL): Paste your image link.

![](https://files.readme.io/bb55cb034b5b5e8ad5f75f476f06d3c82173677791f2b770be1b292cbb26e3fc-Group_20_3.png)

  5. Select **Save** when you're done.
  6. Copy the generated URL and paste it into the **Image URL** field in your AIQUA campaign.



> 👍
> 
> ### 
> 
> Reference
> 
> For full technical details, see [Infobip's Kakao documentation](https://www.infobip.com/docs/kakaotalk/message-types#image-chingu-talk).

* * *

## 

Track clicks with an AIQUA short URL

You can add an short URL into a campaign creative to track clicks, allowing for click-through attribution for Kakao campaigns. The system generates a unique `aiq.is` link (for example, `aiq.is/abc123`) for each user.

To add one, select **`{...}`** > **Short URL** and enter your **Destination URL**. The variable is automatically replaced with the tracking link when the message is sent. Ensure your destination URL meets the following requirements:

  * Must begin with `http://` or `https://`.
  * Don't use a generated short URL as the destination for another AIQUA short URL.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Third-party short URLs limitations
> 
> You can use third-party short URLs as the destination URL, but be aware of the following limitations:
> 
>   * Click tracking for third-party links will not be counted in [campaign performance metrics](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-view-performance#message-campaigns).
>   * Multiple redirects might cause slower loading times for the users.
>

# Kakao Moment Creatives

Learn how to design Kakao Moment creatives.

Kakao Moment templates are predefined message formats that you can use to create your [Kakao Moment campaigns](doc:campaigns-message-create-kakao-moment). Each campaign uses one template type. AIQUA offers five template types for Kakao Moment.

![](https://files.readme.io/d52470d83ecea600a1ea7825a2eb1bf5d1002e6878ee8c20e9fcb5543f6bd49d-Kakao-moment-creatives.png)

![Text](https://files.readme.io/18743692bd54793495a1302febc09f56d3157c07233a9ead2cfc3dc410d96e8f-creative_template.png) Text ![Wide image](https://files.readme.io/6da847adfe91f308c0aa3348300bdd594b3f12fe12bb4756d7d6f4dbab8c772b-creative_template-1.png) Wide image ![Wide list](https://files.readme.io/d75959c30b9cb9132d71b1229f6c98ebe02345f07f5736d0c2aaf32c20bd24e6-creative_template-2.png) Wide list ![Carousel commerce](https://files.readme.io/dd5c34512105a812342a54a14ea86ef8ec69244ecf33af79a26815d1a7dd5d96-creative_template-3.png) Carousel commerce ![Carousel feed](https://files.readme.io/96464db04bfb73809831e3192c2eff26b328755f56923f9424591fd2c2fef365-creative_template-4.png) Carousel feed

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Notes and limitations
> 
>   * To avoid account penalties, you must map dynamic content to a valid Kakao variable type and ensure the data follows strict Kakao variable requirements.
>   * Character limits are calculated after dynamic content substitution. Make sure your final content stays within the specified limits.
> 


* * *

## 

Text

Use the **Text** template to send simple messages with optional images and action buttons.

![](https://files.readme.io/f6d365aab93ec6192f1806c991c1ac3876d6db6e997314a92fd45d8e9448e33b-Kakao-moment-text.png)

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Label content as advertising**|  No| When enabled, your message is labeled as advertising content to comply with Kakao's policies.| -  
**Message**|  Yes| The text body of your message. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| • Plain text: Up to 400 characters  
• With an image: Up to 300 characters  
**Image**|  No| Add an image file to your message.| • Supported file formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG   
• Images must be RGB color mode  
• Recommended aspect ratio and image size:  
800 x 400 (2:1), 800 x 800 (1:1), 800 x 600 (4:3)  
**Buttons**|  No| Add up to two action buttons with a **Destination URL** or **KakaoTalk PC URL**.| URLs must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
* * *

## 

Wide image

Use the **Wide image** template to send visually focused messages with minimal text.

![](https://files.readme.io/489a9c2937f8c17f195db827531656f514f2cb24966c93c8eff26f8eb67c878d-Kakao-moment-wide-image.png)

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Label content as advertising**|  No| When enabled, your message is labeled as advertising content to comply with Kakao's policies.| -  
**Message**|  Yes| The text body of your message. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| Up to 76 characters  
**Image**|  Yes| Add an image file and add a **Destination URL** to specify where users go when they tap the message.| • Supported file formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG   
• Images must be RGB color mode  
• Supported file size: Up to 10 MB  
• Recommended aspect ratio: 4:3   
• Recommended image size: 800 x 600 pixels  
• Destination URL must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
**Buttons**|  No| Add up to two action buttons with a **Destination URL** or **KakaoTalk PC URL**.| URLs must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
* * *

## 

Wide list

Use the **Wide list** template to showcase multiple items in a single message. This template lets you display three or four cards, each with its own image, text, and optional link.

![](https://files.readme.io/370576a86857517593dd10ce2caa52965de2530937d2a76bac3c2b858a7fbfbb-Kakao-moment-wide-list.png)

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Label content as advertising**|  No| When enabled, your message is labeled as advertising content to comply with Kakao's policies.| -  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| Up to 20 characters  
**List items**|  Yes| Add up to four cards to your message. Each card can contain an **Image** and **Message**. Click expand icon to add **Destination URL**.| Requires a minimum of three cards  
**Image**|  Yes| Add an image file for the card.| • Supported file formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG  
• Supported file size: Up to 10 MB  
• Supported aspect ratio: Up to 1:2.5   
• Recommended image size:   
\- First card: 800 x 400 pixels  
Other cards: 400 x 400 pixels  
**Message**|  Yes| The text body of the card. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| Up to 30 characters  
**Buttons**|  No| Add up to two action buttons with a **Destination URL** or **KakaoTalk PC URL**.| • **Button text** : Up to 8 characters   
• Destination URLs must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
* * *

## 

Carousel commerce

Use the Carousel commerce template to display product cards with images, titles, and pricing. You can add up to six carousel cards, and optionally include an intro card.

![](https://files.readme.io/6acc1ec031f860489aa7a0bbcd451a77c34a3cdc7ca40c988a112e8c8b41bf4e-Kakao-moment-carousel.png)

### 

Carousel cards

Configure at least two carousel cards, and up to six cards with your product information.

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Image**|  Yes| Add an image file for the card.| • Supported file formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG   
• Images must be RGB color mode  
• Recommended aspect ratio and image size:  
800 x 400 (2:1), 800 x 800 (1:1), 800 x 600 (4:3)  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| Up to 25 characters  
**Price**|  Yes| The product price.| Supported currencies and specifications:  
• Won (₩) and Yen (￥): Integers only (0 to 99,999,999)  
• Dollars ($) and Euro (€): Up to two decimal places  
**Discount price**|  No| The discounted product price.| • Won (₩) and Yen (￥): Integers only (0 to 99,999,999)  
• Dollars ($) and Euro (€): Displayed to two decimal places (rounded down if three or fewer decimal places)  
• Must be at least 1% lower than the regular price  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the product card. Use a static URL or dynamic content.| Destination URL must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
**Buttons**|  No| Add an action button with a **Destination URL**.| • **Button text** : Up to 8 characters   
• URLs must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
### 

(Optional) Intro card

Add an intro card to introduce your promotion. When enabled, this card appears before your carousel cards.

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Image**|  Yes| Add an image file for the card.| • Supported file formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG   
• Images must be RGB color mode  
• Recommended aspect ratio and image size:  
800 x 400 (2:1), 800 x 800 (1:1), 800 x 600 (4:3)  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| Up to 20 characters  
**Message**|  Yes| The text body of the card. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| Up to 50 characters  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the product card. Use a static URL or dynamic content .| Destination URL must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
* * *

## 

Carousel feed

Use the **Carousel feed** template to share multiple content pieces in a swipeable format.

![](https://files.readme.io/1b8baa1fc4417d7da2cead1cc7e4fb110bc440c731a61317c13d977ad10b58df-Kakao-moment-carousel-feed.png)

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Image**|  Yes| Add an image file for the card.| • Supported file formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG   
• Images must be RGB color mode  
• Recommended aspect ratio and image size:  
800 x 400 (2:1), 800 x 600 (4:3)  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| Up to 20 characters  
**Message**|  Yes| The text body of the card. Use plain text, dynamic content, or emoji.| Up to 180 characters  
**Buttons**|  No| Add up to two action buttons with **Destination URLs**.| • **Button text** : Up to 8 characters  
• URLs must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
* * *

## 

Dynamic content

You can personalize Kakao messages using [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) based on user attributes or event parameters.

To add dynamic content, click `{...}` and select your variable. Note that **Title** and **Message** fields in Kakao messages have strict variable mapping requirements.

![](https://files.readme.io/a6b65e28355149675396b3055a6613c444eee854223862fc0ea71a3d61f51a40-kakao-moment-dynamic-content.png)

### 

Supported templates and fields

Dynamic content can be used in the following fields:

Template| Supported fields  
---|---  
Text| • **Message**  
• **Destination URL**  
• **KakaoTalk PC URL**  
Wide image| • **Message**  
• **Destination URL**  
• **KakaoTalk PC URL**  
Wide list| • **Title**  
• **Message**  
• **Destination URL**  
• **KakaoTalk PC URL**  
Carousel commerce| • **Title**  
• **Message**  
• **Destination URL**  
Carousel feed| • **Title**  
• **Message**  
• **Destination URL**  
  
### 

Variable mapping requirements

Unlike other channels, Kakao requires you to map dynamic content used in **Title** or **Message** fields to a specific Kakao variable type. Use the **Variable type** dropdown to select the matching format.

![](https://files.readme.io/54e3240eb63c02bd4c2295eb5883c7098136e141bfe6f9b9a769c10809b9bb7c-kakao-dynamic-content-variable-type.png)

To avoid account penalties from Kakao, you must meet the following requirements:

  * Data type: Ensure that the dynamic content mapped to a **Variable type** strictly follows the [Kakao variable specifications](https://developers.kakao.com/docs/latest/en/kakaomoment/creatives-personalized-message#variable-specification).
  * Number available: Each Kakao variable type has a limit on how many times it can be used in a single campaign.
  * Length: The dynamic content must not exceed the character limit defined for the Kakao variable type.



### 

Automatic variable mapping

AIQUA automatically maps dynamic content variables that align with the suggested data format to the corresponding Kakao variable types.

The following tables list the preset mappings for attributes and event parameters:

#### 

Attributes

Dynamic content variable| Preset variable type  
---|---  
`user_id`| **User ID**  
`birthday`| **Date**  
`name`| **User name**  
  
#### 

Event parameters

Dynamic content variable| Preset variable type  
---|---  
`product_id`| **Product ID**  
`product_price`| **Price - regular**  
`product_name`| **Product name**  
`user_id`| **User ID**  
`rating`| **User rating**

# LINE Creatives

Learn how to design LINE creatives.

LINE creatives are message formats that let you send content to users through [LINE campaigns](doc:campaigns-message-create-line). AIQUA offers several template types for LINE, from simple text messages to interactive carousel templates. You can add up to five messages in a campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/a4427782c366bb2e74b77695fe654f77ba031e539ea7bbe3f7cdc76b55aeeee4-LINE-creatives.png)

![Rich message](https://files.readme.io/ea9f584d8471096c86374dc6ec9c9cd6bd25cec52879f8c1e3fcbf07ae007da1-Rich_message.png) Rich message ![Text](https://files.readme.io/3c0fbc56bfd859f820f3f1058bf72853e1d2a3213b9b3ad5abbf87fbf87d0268-Text.png) Text ![Image](https://files.readme.io/5e0ed8abe624fcffa1e7163a2275ec38099483e9a50718d264898b56dcb044c5-Photo.png) Image ![Video](https://files.readme.io/030e930c746994a9a4f2c498c472e89ad8098b3e10c1237331b3660ae1cb7894-Video.png) Video ![Carousel template](https://files.readme.io/5dce81c60a12fc4adfcd86cf2b7e7427e18c539c161efc56de367e05a9daffc9-Carousel.png) Carousel template

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Notes and limitations
> 
>   * All LINE messages sent with listed template types above are fully supported on the LINE Desktop App.
>   * Character limits count are based on the number of characters, regardless of language. There's no distinction between half-width and full-width.
>   * When you use dynamic content in text fields like **Alternative text** , **Title** , **Description** , or **Button label** , any text that exceeds the character limit will be automatically trimmed.
>   * Live preview isn't available. The preview panel shows a static template. To review your actual content, select **Send test creative**.
> 


* * *

## 

Rich message

Rich messages let you send images with clickable areas that link to different destinations. You can define up to 10 tappable areas on each image, perfect for creating interactive experiences.

![](https://files.readme.io/b288ebd027a026159596c1560749e500776d5e85a18c721b521b6b7500c22de0-image_16.png)

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Image**|  Yes| Add a background image for the rich message.| • Maximum file size: 10 MB   
• Recommended width: 1040 pixels or larger  
**Clickable areas**|  Yes| Add up to 10 clickable areas. Click **\+ Add clickable area** to place a selection block on the image, then add your destination URL.   
  
You can freely reposition the block to specify where users select to reach the destination URL.| Must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
**Alternative text**|  Yes| This text appears in the LINE chats list preview and only when this message is first in your campaign queue. Use [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), or emoji.| Up to 400 characters  
  
* * *

## 

Text

The **Text** is perfect for sending simple, plain text messages in your campaign.

![](https://files.readme.io/cf6d6034a7b7b0d4182dfbfa0effaef4336e4e06727c07af04a16614851fc92b-image_17.png)

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Message**|  Yes| The text body of your message. Use plain text, [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), or emoji.| Up to 500 characters  
  
* * *

## 

Image

Use **Image** messages to send static images that showcase your products, promotions, or visual highlights. Each image is sent as an individual message.

![](https://files.readme.io/6e63f5ba76b8fc536b8799070d472a93a7bdba9046ec9338d204e80a5d6c4bf5-image_18.png)

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Image**|  Yes| Add an image file to your chat.| • Recommended image size: 1024 x 1024 pixels   
• Maximum file size: 10 MB  
  
* * *

## 

Video

The **Video** creative lets you send short MP4 videos with an optional cover image to engage your users.

![](https://files.readme.io/3acd8d96708d94f82ce55c341331eeb2c9a04ae65f28db0a4f34c795a5a8d7bb-image_19.png)

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Video**|  Yes| Add a video file to your chat.| • Supported length: Up to 1 minute   
• Maximum file size: 100 MB  
• Supported file type: MP4  
**Cover image**|  No| Add a preview image that's displayed before the video plays.| • Maximum file size: 1 MB  
• Supported file type: JPEG   
• Supported image size: 240 x 240 pixels  
  
* * *

## 

Carousel templates

**Carousel template** lets you display up to 10 cards in a single, interactive message. Users can swipe through cards that include text with [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), images, and action buttons. There are two available template types:

![](https://files.readme.io/6c66aa636e7c28691190c7e29079e564b9bb7ea8d27678f7ef35600939d0f7c4-LINE-carousel.png)

Type| Description  
---|---  
**Carousel template**|  This template displays creative content with an image, text, and a call-to-action for each card. For more configuration settings and specifications, see Carousel template.  
**Image carousel template**|  This template creates a visual-first message where images serve as the primary content. In an image carousel, the image is used as a background, and the action button is placed as an overlay on the image. For more configuration settings and specifications, see Image carousel template.  
  
### 

Carousel template

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Alternative text**|  Yes| This text appears in the LINE chats list preview. Use [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), or emoji.| Up to 400 characters  
**Thumbnail aspect ratio**|  Yes| Select **No image** to create text only carousel cards or select an aspect ratio for your thumbnail image:  
  
• **Rectangle**   
• **Square**|  -  
**Number of buttons**|  Yes| Configure up to three action buttons globally that apply to all cards.| -  
**Button type**|  Yes| Set the action button type to **URI** , **Message** , or **Postback**.   
  
• **URI** : Redirect users to the destination page.   
• **Message** : When the user taps the action button, a text is sent in the channel as a message from the user.   
• **Postback** : To send a postback event to the server via webhook.| Must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
**Image**|  Yes| Add an image for each carousel card.| • Maximum file size: 10 MB   
• Recommended width: 1024 pixels or larger  
• Aspect ratio: 1.51:1 (**Rectangle**) or 1:1 (**Square**)  
**Image destination URI**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap on the image.| Must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
**Title**|  No| The title text appears above the description. Available only when **Add title** is enabled in **Template settings**.| Up to 40 characters  
**Description**|  No| The supporting text appears below the title.| • No image or title: Up to 120 characters   
• Message with an image or title: Up to 60 characters  
**Button label**|  Yes| The action button text.| Up to 20 characters  
**Button destination URI**|  Yes| The page that opens when users tap.| Must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
### 

Image carousel template

Setting| Required| Description| Specifications  
---|---|---|---  
**Alternative text**|  Yes| This text appears in the LINE chats list preview. Use [dynamic content](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives), or emoji.| Up to 400 characters  
**Image**|  Yes| Add a background image for each carousel card.| • Maximum file size: 10 MB   
• Recommended image size: 1024 × 1024 pixels   
• Aspect ratio: 1:1  
**Button label**|  Yes| The action button text.| Up to 12 characters  
**Button destination URI**|  Yes| The page that opens when users tap.| Must begin with `http://` or `https://`  
  
> 👍
> 
> ### 
> 
> Reference
> 
> For detailed technical specifications and additional information about LINE message formats, refer to the official [LINE Messaging API documentation](https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#message-objects).

* * *

## 

Dynamic content

You can personalize LINE notifications using dynamic content based on user attributes, events, or product recommendations. To add dynamic content, click **`{...}`** and select one of the following options:

  * [**User attributes** or **User events**](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#based-on-attributes-and-events): Displays specific user attributes or details from past interactions, such as a user's name or the last item they viewed.
  * [**Recommendations**](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#based-on-product-recommendations): Displays personalized product recommendations.

![](https://files.readme.io/42a87d8fb5558e89f8b5026e0b8d6743010451326ce5463ccd2f246f1fab7a4e-line-dynamic-content.png)

When creating [trigger](doc:campaigns-message-create-line#trigger-rule) campaigns, you can also use [**Feed trigger**](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#based-on-feed-triggers) as a dynamic content source to display products with recent feed updates.

### 

Supported templates and fields

Dynamic content can be used in the following fields for each template type:

Template| Supported fields  
---|---  
Rich message| • **Alternative text**  
Text| • **Alternative text**  
Image| None  
Video| None  
Carousel template| • **Alternative text**  
• **Image URL**  
• **Image destination URI**  
• **Title**  
• **Description**  
• **Button label**  
• **Button destination URI**  
  
> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Notes
> 
> Not all fields support dynamic content. If **`{...}`** icon doesn't exist, dynamic content isn't supported for that field.

# Push Creatives

Learn how to design push creatives.

Create your push message notifications for users on Android, iOS, and web with dynamic content and available creative templates. To learn about the platform-specific creative templates, refer to the following guides:

[ ![Android push](https://files.readme.io/997bf825aaec4b6293090aa968a394bc85cf3f924ba6494f04948d1844540f6e-Android.png) Android push ](/docs/creatives-android-push) [ ![iOS push](https://files.readme.io/06f466c44ffe80f7c9cc1a4ae43745ee2e0e23f25d9c04843fb0c3f686dca333-Ios.png) iOS push ](/docs/creatives-ios-push) [ ![Web push](https://files.readme.io/4962c5b325527e7752f186dec94f0ba92dd206b5d55ab9d101f51967490cc79a-Website.png) Web push ](/docs/creatives-web-push)

* * *

## 

Dynamic content

You can personalize push notifications using dynamic content based on user attributes, events, or product recommendations. To add dynamic content, click **`{...}`** and select one of the following options:

  * [**User attributes** or **User events**](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#based-on-attributes-and-events): Displays specific user attributes or details from past interactions, such as a user's name or the last item they viewed.
  * [**Recommendations**](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#based-on-product-recommendations): Displays personalized product recommendations.

![](https://files.readme.io/fa003e2f21d180f50f8b38fd323fe92d3ed1561eeea531e1d3622f50dc186d48-push-dynamic-content.png)

When creating [trigger](doc:campaigns-message-create-push#trigger-rule) campaigns, you can also use [**Feed trigger**](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives#based-on-feed-triggers) as a dynamic content source to display products with recent feed updates.

### 

Supported fields

Dynamic content can be used in the following fields across all push template types:

  * Common settings (all platforms): **Title** , **Subtitle** , **Message** , and **Destination URL**
  * Template-specific settings:
    * Image URLs: **Banner image** , **Carousel image** , **Large icon** , and **Media URL**.
    * Deep links for **Carousel** and **Slider**.
    * Button text and links for web push creatives: **Standard** and **2 Images**.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Notes
> 
>   * Not all fields support dynamic content. If **`{...}`** icon doesn't exist, dynamic content isn't supported for that field.
>   * The [**Subscription**](doc:creatives-android-push-subscription) template type doesn't support using dynamic content in their template-specific settings, but common settings are still able to use dynamic content.
>

# SMS/MMS Creatives

Learn how to design SMS/MMS creatives.

SMS, MMS, and LMS creatives send text messages directly to users' mobile devices. Choose the creative type that best fits your message content and regional requirements.

![SMS](https://files.readme.io/552ec9a210778406df3f83b05d1d762485e9af23e1d695f234e065cdb294c4fc-sms.png) SMS ![MMS](https://files.readme.io/48d66e5f57fcf02d30f23f3029f01934672da520bc25b6e4937d3e23721d657e-mms.png) MMS

* * *

## 

SMS

### 

Standard SMS specifications

![](https://files.readme.io/493d7242eaaa99ae1fe595ac90a2a8adcdbe80aee4b27e1959a909488d57c83e-SMS.png)

SMS sends text-only messages to users' mobile devices. Enter your message text in the **Message** field. The message can contain an AIQUA short URL for tracking clicks, as well as emojis and dynamic content.

| Specifications  
---|---  
Character limits| For message in standard GSM-7 encoding:   
• A message with up to 160 characters sends as a single part.   
• A message longer than 160 characters splits into parts of 153 characters each.   
For messages with Unicode characters:  
• A message with up to 70 characters sends as a single part.   
• A message longer than 70 characters splits into parts of 67 characters each.The character counter doesn't include characters from dynamic content. The actual message size varies by recipient.  
Credit usage| When your message exceeds the character limit, the message is automatically split it into multiple parts. Each part that is sent consumes one SMS credit.  
Messages can be split into up to six parts. We recommend keeping messages under four parts to ensure compatibility with all service providers.  
For example, when you send a 200-character GSM message, the system automatically splits it into two parts: a first part of 153 characters and a second part of 47 characters. This message consumes two SMS credits.  
  
### 

LMS specifications

Long Message Service (LMS) allows you to send longer text-only messages to your users in South Korea. LMS is automatically activated when your message exceeds 90 characters, with an additional **Subject for LMS** field that appears in brackets at the beginning of the message.

| Specifications  
---|---  
Character limits| • GSM-7 encoding: Up to 2,000 characters.   
• Unicode encoding: Up to 1,000 characters.  
Credit usage| Each message uses one LMS credit.  
**Subject for LMS**|  • GSM-7 encoding: Up to 66 characters.   
• Unicode encoding: Up to 33 characters.  
  
* * *

## 

MMS

![](https://files.readme.io/687737faee8b5f582e0dca77cf9480f202df2bddcab25066d87143c3a57038c3-MMS.png)

MMS sends messages with media files, such as images.

| Specifications  
---|---  
**Subject**|  • Up to 40 characters.   
• When the subject and message are the same, only the message will be displayed on some devices.  
• Avoid using special characters in the subject: `&`, `<`, `>`, `“`, `‘`. These characters might not be displayed correctly for some users. Alternatively, you can use the equivalent characters in full width.  
**Message**|  The main message of the notification. You can add an AIQUA short URL for tracking clicks, as well as emojis and dynamic content.  
**Media**|  • Supported file types: GIF, JPG, JPEG, PNG.  
• Users may need to tap the media file to see the image depending on their device and carrier.  
Size limit| The combined size of the subject, media files, and message body cannot exceed 256 KB. If a message exceeds 256 KB due to dynamic content, the MMS won't be sent to that recipient and no credits will be charged.  
Credit usage| For messages sent successfully:   
• Less than 50 KB: 3 MMS credits   
• 50 KB to 256 KB: 5 MMS credits  
Delivery rate limit| You can send up to 25,000 MMS messages per hour.  
  
* * *

## 

Dynamic content and short URLs

You can add dynamic content and short URLs in the **Message** field of SMS, MMS, or LMS messages by clicking **`{...}`** and selecting one of the following options:

  * **User attributes** or **User events** : Insert variables into the message and populate them based on the recipient's attribute or event data, for example, by adding their name into the message. If you add dynamic content, you'll be able to provide a **Default message** to send if the dynamic content can't be populated.
  * **Short URL** : Add an AIQUA short URL to track clicks on the message.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Character count: Dynamic content
> 
> Note that the character counter displayed in the console excludes dynamic content. The resulting message length may vary by recipient.

![](https://files.readme.io/e0958f07842f2aedd7f22d6026b6ef036a6a6e2636ccfba0501c67f208cc248c-regular-sms-dynamic-content.png)

### 

Track clicks with an AIQUA short URL

Use AIQUA short URLs to track clicks and click-through attribution for your SMS/MMS [campaign performance](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-view-performance#sms) metrics. When you add a short URL, AIQUA generates a unique tracking link for each recipient using the `aiq.is` domain (for example, `aiq.is/abc123`). The generated short URL is up to 13 characters long.

To add a short URL, click **`{...}> Short URL`**, and then enter your **Destination URL**. The AIQUA short URL will replace the **Short URL** variable in your final message. Ensure your destination URL meets the following requirements:

  * The destination URL must use HTTP or HTTPS.
  * The destination URL can't be another AIQUA short URL.



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Third-party shortened URLs
> 
> Although using short URLs from a third-party service as the destination URL is supported, note that the
> 
>   * Click tracking on these shortened URLs will not be counted in [campaign performance metrics](doc:performance-and-reports-campaign-performance-view-performance#sms).
>   * Users might experience longer loading times due to multiple redirects are required to reach the final destination page.
> 


![](https://files.readme.io/b32e42eeb497e18c6be89dca2ad43e1548f714b9c486ac27097b8662ac9bbf50-sms-short-url.gif)

# Standard

A standard web push sends a notification with text, a deep link, and an icon. You can optionally add an image or up to two action buttons.

![](https://files.readme.io/2dba1c7cf58a01239746ce34b83ba33baa80f612fbeee5aa32743f5ee34cc8d5-web-standard-push.png)

* * *

## 

Regular campaigns

A standard web push requires the following configuration:

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30 characters or less  
**Subtitle**|  No| Extra text that appears below the title. Only available for iOS and Android.| —  
**Message**|  Yes| This is the main message of the notification. Can be static or [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) text or emoji. Keep the message concise and compelling. Long messages are automatically trimmed based on the user's screen size.| Recommended:   
  
• With image: Must be 45 characters or less   
• Without image: Must be 150 characters or less  
**Icon**|  Yes| Upload an icon image to display with the web push notification.| Recommended icon size: 192 x 192 pixels  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the notification. Enter a web URL or deep link to a specific page or screen in your app. If not set, users go to your default website.  
  
Options:  
• **Single URL for all channels**  
• **Custom URL per channel**|  —  
**Image**|  No| Toggle on to optionally add an image with a close to 2:1 aspect ratio. We recommend reducing file size to optimize delivery.| Recommended image size:   
  
• With button: 973 x 484 pixels   
• Without button: 1024 x 512 pixels  
**Button**|  No| Add up to two action buttons with an optional icon link in the notification:   
  
• Text   
• (Optional) Deep link   
• (Optional) Button's icon| Recommended icon size: 192 x 192 pixels  
**Drip notification**|  No| A secondary notification that displays if the user dismisses the first notification.| —

# 2 Images (2 Images Poster)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> Contact Appier Support ([[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#91f4e2e2cee2e4e1e1fee3e5d1f0e1e1f8f4e3bff2fefc)) to activate this creative type.

The **2 Images** creative displays two images side by side. You can choose between two width proportions: **3:2** and **1:1**.

![](https://files.readme.io/f3fe57592a80b88d9f43b0c98b0fe0dfcac44e7c99e0b8c4c53757645bace268-web-2-images.png)

* * *

## 

Regular campaigns

A **2 Images** creative requires the following configuration:

Setting| Required| Description| Specification  
---|---|---|---  
**Title**|  Yes| Your notification's title. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji. Keep it short and eye-catching.| Recommended: 30 characters  
**Subtitle**|  No| Extra text that appears below the title. Only available for iOS and Android.| —  
**Message**|  Yes| Your main notification message. Use plain text, [dynamic](doc:dynamic-content-for-personalizing-creatives) content, or emoji.| Recommended: 45 characters (fits in one line on most devices)  
**Icon**|  Yes| Upload an icon image to display with the web push notification.| Recommended: 192 x 192 pixels  
**Destination URL**|  Yes| Specify where users go when they tap the notification. Enter a web URL or deep link to a specific page or screen in your app. If not set, users go to your default website.  
  
Options:  
• **Single URL for all channels**  
• **Custom URL per channel**|  —  
**Layout**|  Yes| Select the width proportion of the two images:   
  
• **1:1**   
• **3:2**|  —  
**Images**|  Yes| Upload two images for left and right positions.| Recommended images size for each layout:   
  
• 1:1 layout: 900 x 900 pixels   
• 3:2 layout:   
\- Image on the left: 1094 x 900 pixels   
\- Image on the right: 706 x 900 pixels  
**Button**|  No| Add up to two action buttons with an optional icon. Each button redirects users to a separate URL and requires the following configurations:   
  
• **Text**   
• **Deep link**   
• **Icon**|  • Recommended button text: 20 characters or less   
• Recommended icon size: 192 x 192 pixels  
**Drip notification**|  No| A secondary notification that displays if the user dismisses the first notification.| —  
  
> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Notes
> 
>   * If the uploaded image size doesn't match the recommended image size, the image is resized to fit the width or height of the recommended size.
>   * If the image ratio doesn't match:
>     * The aspect ratio is maintained.
>     * Empty space is filled with a white background.
>     * The image is center-aligned.
>

# Cross-Domain Integration

## 

Overview

Refer to the following sections for notes and limitations regarding cross-domain integration with the Appier Web SDK:

  * Businesses using multiple domains
  * Websites using multiple subdomains
  * Event attribution across domains or subdomains



> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> User segmentation can be done across domains or subdomains as long as the user is using the **same device** and **same browser**.

* * *

## 

Multiple domains

In general, if you use multiple domains, for example, "[www.abc.com"](http://www.abc.com%22), "[www.abc2.com"](http://www.abc2.com%22), and "[www.abc-blog.com"](http://www.abc-blog.com%22), you should have a **separate AIQUA account for each domain**.

If you have multiple domains under one AIQUA account, the following features are affected:

### 

In-web campaigns: Events within 24 hours

Filtering audience based on events within 24 hours does not work across multiple domains. See [here](doc:campaigns-in-web#guidelines-and-limitations) for more details.

### 

Web push subscription

A user's subscription to push notifications does not carry across domains. As a result, users who have already allowed or blocked notifications will see the system prompt again when they visit a different domain. If the user allows or blocks notifications in the second system prompt, the user's latest push subscription status will be applied.

![](https://files.readme.io/b92407e-Screen_Shot_2022-04-19_at_4.07.05_PM.png)

* * *

## 

Multiple subdomains

If your website has multiple subdomains, for example, "shop.abc.com", "m.shop.abc.com", and "blog.abc.com", the following features are affected:

  * In-web campaigns: Events within 24 hours
  * Web push subscriptions



### 

In-web campaigns: Events within 24 hours

Filtering audience based on events within 24 hours does not work across multiple subdomains. See [here](doc:campaigns-in-web#guidelines-and-limitations) for more details.

### 

Web push subscriptions

Under default settings, a user's push subscription also does not carry across subdomains, but you can follow the steps below to avoid having users opt-in for each subdomain.

  * **Scenario 1** Let's say you have multiple subdomains, but only want to enable web push on one subdomain "shop.abc.com". Simply restrict web push to that subdomain only.
    1. On AIQUA dashboard, click on your account name in the lower-left corner and select **Integration > Website**.
    2. Under **Enable Web Push** , select **Restrict web push in specific websites only** , and type "shop.abc.com".

![1588](https://files.readme.io/6d0eb3b-Screen_Shot_2020-02-17_at_6.00.08_PM.png)

In this example, web push will be enabled on "shop.abc.com" but not on subdomains that are not listed here, such as "m.shop.abc.com" or "job.abc.com".

  * **Scenario 2** Let's say there are three subdomains, and you want to enable web push on two of them: "shop.abc.com" and "blog.abc.com".
    1. Contact Appier Support ([[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a1c4d2d2fed2d4d1d1ced3d5e1c0d1d1c8c4d38fc2cecc)) to enable cross-domain SDK functionality for the following domains: "shop.abc.com" and "blog.abc.com".
    2. Make sure Appier Web SDK is integrated on "shop.abc.com" and "blog.abc.com".
    3. Because there is a third subdomain that doesn't need web push, you need to restrict web push to "shop.abc.com" and "blog.abc.com" only on AIQUA dashboard. Refer to instructions listed for scenario 1.



* * *

## 

Event attribution across domains and subdomains

Under default settings, events that happened on a different domain are not attributed to the campaign. This means that if the user receives an AIQUA notification on domain A and completes an event on domain B, the event will not be properly attributed to the AIQUA notification in the performance report. A common scenario is when the main website has a different domain from the checkout pages because the payment flow is on a separate site.

If you want to track event attribution across domains, you can use one of the methods below. Note that both domains have to be integrated with the same Appier Web SDK.

  * **Method 1** You can call the `navigateWithAttributions` method in any element which will navigate to the next domain. Using this method, we'll automatically append attribution data in the target URL and navigate to that page.



HTML
    
    
    <a onclick="appier('navigateWithAttributions', 'https://www.NEXT-DOMAIN.com')">
        Navigate
    </a>

  * **Method 2** Alternatively, you can retrieve attribution data directly by calling Appier Web SDK's `getAttributions` method. The returned attribution data can then be appended to the next domain's URL as a list of query parameters, as demonstrated in the following example:



HTML
    
    
    <a id="navigate" href="https://www.NEXT-DOMAIN.com">
      Navigate
    </a>
    
    <script>
      appier('getAttributions', (attrs) => {
        if (attrs) {
          const { viewAttribution, clickAttribution } = attrs;
          const linkElement = document.getElementById('navigate');
    
          const newHref = new URL(linkElement.getAttribute('href'));
    
          if (viewAttribution) {
            const { notificationId, action, ts } = viewAttribution;
            newHref.searchParams.set(
              'aiq_view_attr',
              `${notificationId}.${action}.${ts}`
            );
          }
    
          if (clickAttribution) {
            const { notificationId, action, ts } = clickAttribution;
            newHref.searchParams.set(
              'aiq_click_attr',
              `${notificationId}.${action}.${ts}`
            );
          }
    
          linkElement.setAttribute('href', newHref.href);
        }
      });
    </script>

# (Optional) Customizing Notification Sounds

Configure a custom Android push notification sound.

## 

Sound file requirements

  * The sound file URL must be an HTTPS URL.
  * Supported file formats:
    * 3GPP (`.3gp`)
    * MPEG-4 (`.mp4`, `.m4a`)
    * ADTS raw AAC (`.aac`, decode in Android 3.1+, encode in Android 4.0+, ADIF not supported)
    * MPEG-TS (`.ts`, not seekable, Android 3.0+)
    * FLAC (`.flac`)
    * Type 0 and 1 (`.mid`, `.xmf`, `.mxmf`)
    * RTTTL/RTX (`.rtttl`, `.rtx`)
    * OTA (`.ota`)
    * iMelody (`.imy`)
    * MP3 (`.mp3`)
    * WAV (`.wav`)



For more details on the supported audio formats and codecs, see this [Android Audio Support guide](https://developer.android.com/guide/topics/media/media-formats#audio-codecs).

* * *

## 

Configure a custom notification sound

In the campaign's creative settings, under **Template > Notification center settings**, select **Pile up notification** , check **Customize notification sound** , then enter the URL of the sound file.

![](https://files.readme.io/76d5a3fd7e6879d4609bb75fdfb41e5a7ddb063b053bd9a7e6f94424699f7449-android-customize-notification-sound.png)

# (Optional) Customizing Notification Sounds

Configure a custom iOS push notification sound.

## 

Sound file requirements

  * Maximum sound file length: 30 seconds
  * Required sound file format: `aiff`



* * *

## 

Configure a custom notification sound

  1. Place custom sound files in one of the following locations:
     1. The `/Library/Sounds` directory of the app’s container directory.
     2. The `/Library/Sounds` directory of one of the app’s shared group container directories.
     3. The main bundle of the current executable.
  2. In the campaign's creative settings, under **Template** , enable **Customize notification sound** and enter the name of the sound file.
